title: Unit Notice Amount on the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization: Statement Billing Note
content:
**Billing note — the unit notice amount.** For a storage unit agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the noticed due date is the authorization's next draft due date, and the notice is sent only when that due date less the method's number of days before the due date its drafts run falls at least the method's varying-amount notice period, in calendar days, after the handling date. A bank-account draft, which runs before its due date, collects the rent charge of that due date together with the balance due on the draft date.

The latest submitted draft is the draft attempt on the authorization with the latest draft date; while its result is still empty it is in flight and counts at its submitted amount, unless a lien notice fee is posted for the current delinquency, in which case the draft is refused as a partial payment and counts as nothing; a lien notice fee for the current delinquency is a lien notice fee entry on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement ledger whose period is the agreement's oldest unpaid due date. A payment is applied to the oldest charges first, so the in-flight draft and then any catch-up amount on the notice history for the oldest unpaid due date first pay the balance due on the handling date, and only what is left of them reaches the in-flight draft's own due date.

The unit notice amount is the agreement's contracted monthly rent for the noticed due date, plus the past-due balance left after the in-flight draft is applied, plus the contracted monthly rent of the in-flight draft's own due date less the part of the in-flight draft and of the catch-up amount left over after the past-due balance, all added together and rounded to the cent once; each partial figure is rounded to the cent. A notice is sent only for an amount not above the method's draft cap.

### The three parts, defined

1. **Rent of the noticed due date** — the agreement's contracted monthly rent.
2. **Past-due balance left after the in-flight draft** — the balance due on the handling date less the amount the in-flight draft counts at, never below nothing.
3. **Rent of the in-flight draft's due date** — where the latest submitted draft's result is still empty: the contracted monthly rent, less the part of the in-flight draft left over after the balance due on the handling date, less the part of the catch-up amount left over after the past-due balance of part 2, never below nothing. Where the latest submitted draft already has a result, this part is nothing.

### Timing, both sides (hypothetical method figures: drafts 2 days before the due date, notice period 10 days)

Next draft due date the 25th, so the draft runs on the 23rd. A notice handled on the 13th falls 10 days before the 23rd and is sent; one handled on the 14th falls 9 days before and is not.

### Worked figures (hypothetical inputs; contracted monthly rent $150.00, no catch-up amount on record)

| Case | Balance due on the handling date | In-flight draft | Part 1 | Part 2 | Part 3 | Unit notice amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | $180.00 | $150.00 | $150.00 | $30.00 | $150.00 | $330.00 |
| B | $180.00 | $200.00 | $150.00 | $0.00 | $130.00 | $280.00 |
| C | $0.00 | none (latest draft has a result) | $150.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $150.00 |

In case B the in-flight draft of $200.00 pays the $180.00 balance first, and the $20.00 left over reaches its own due date, so part 3 is $150.00 less $20.00.
